text:
Alex K: Jetline just flagged a 'fuel & security surcharge' on the H100 RMA batch — quoted ~USD 4,200 if we ship as separate HAWBs. This will push replacements past our handover window.
Maya P: which AWBs are affected? link to manifest? :thinking:
Alex K: AWBs in the batch: 
```
MAWB: 770-5551234  
HAWB: JET-1001
MAWB: 770-5551235  
HAWB: JET-1002
HAWB: JET-1003
```
Alex K: Jetline says surcharge is per HAWB unless consolidated under a single MAWB and customs docs updated.
ProcurementBot: AWB 770-5551234 -> status: CLEAR; AWB 770-5551235 -> status: PENDING (documentation).
CarrierRep-Jetline: Hi all — correct. The surcharge applies for multiple HAWBs on our express lane. Option: consolidate to one MAWB or sign LOA accepting surcharge. Consolidation needs updated packing list + HS code recert (we flagged 847150 as missing).
Nina (LogisticsOps): We can recert HS 847150 and consolidate, but depot needs 2h to re-stuff pallets. Any deploy risk?
Suresh R: cluster impact: losing ~120 TF of GPU until replacements arrive -> affects nightly jobs and a few canary tenants. We need ETA delta if we take the surcharge vs consolidate.
Tim O: cost question: is the 4.2k total or per unit? need net uplift to PO. Maya, can finance sign off for emergency surcharge?
Maya P: finance needs exact line item. If consolidation saves >$2.5k we prefer that. If only saves ~$200, buyout surcharge and expedite.
CarrierRep-Jetline: surcharge is USD 4,200 total for the split shipment. If consolidated it drops to USD 350 handling fee. We can issue new MAWB by EOD but need a signed HS recert and consolidated packing list.
Alex K: can procurement create the consolidated packing list now? I'll ask depot to start restack.
ProcurementBot: Creating PO amendment draft: 
```
PO# 45233-amend
Item: H100 RMA batch (3 units)
Surcharge_proposed: USD 4200 (split) / USD 350 (consolidated)
Action_deadline: 2024-09-20 18:00 PST
```
Nina (LogisticsOps): Depot can re-stuff, ETA to carrier cut 3.5h after LOA. If we sign LOA instead (no restuff), carrier will schedule original slots but surcharge applies.
Suresh R: prefer consolidation to avoid long-term OPEX hit and customs rework. We can spin up extra burst capacity from cloud for two nights to cover canaries if needed.
Tim O: okay — procurement, please proceed with consolidation path. Maya, Suresh: approve cost reallocation for depot overtime (estimate USD 600).
Maya P: approved for up to USD 800. Go ahead. :+1:
CarrierRep-Jetline: I'll mark shipment for consolidation on our side once we receive the signed HS recert and consolidated packing list. We can waive the 350 fee if you provide LOA for liability shift. Need confirmation by 18:00 PST.
Alex K: signing LOA is fine if it further reduces risk — but we want consolidated MAWB. I'll upload signed docs within 2h.
ProcurementBot: Amendment uploaded to PO 45233-amend. Attach: consolidated_packinglist_45233.pdf
Tim O: flagging follow-up: post-delivery confirm serial reconciliation across depots and update asset inventory. Create ticket for depot reconciliation.
Nina (LogisticsOps): creating ticket now -> LOG-7839. Will attach AWB scans when done.
CarrierRep-Jetline: thanks — we'll proceed once docs arrive. Closing note: if docs miss the 18:00 window, surcharge will be applied automatically.
Alex K: copy. I’ll chase depot and confirm in 30m. :eyes:
